tagline: A guesthouse in Gurubebila, between Midigama and Weligama, on the south coast of Sri Lanka.
closing: Booking.com has the live dates and prices. If you'd rather ask something first, call us.

copyBlocks.heading: By the beach
copyBlocks.body:
The guesthouse is tucked away from the busy Galle–Matara road, right next to the beach.

Next to the guesthouse is a large open grassed area overlooking the beach, where the friendly locals and tourists alike gather to watch the surf, play cricket, socialise and enjoy beautiful sunrises and sunsets.

copyBlocks.heading: The Eranga family home
copyBlocks.body:
Coconut Surf Inn is the Eranga family home, so staying here means you will experience the endless warm smiles and kind hospitality of the gracious host Chinthaka and his family.

Chinthaka has been a host on Airbnb for 13 years.

copyBlocks.heading: The restaurant upstairs
copyBlocks.body:
A long covered room on the upper floor, with cushioned benches, low tables and a view of the sea. All meals, snacks and drinks are available. Breakfast comes with some rates and not with others.

The restaurant has its own Google listing, Coconut Surf Restaurant (2nd floor), where it's rated 4.6 from 39 reviews.

copyBlocks.heading: On the roof
copyBlocks.body: The terrace up top is shaded with thatch, and has a swing seat, hammocks, benches and tables. Beyond the palms, the sea.

copyBlocks.heading: Inside the house
copyBlocks.body:
The middle of the house is a skylit courtyard. Palms grow out of a shallow channel of water there, between the windows of the rooms.

There are hammocks on the verandas, an outdoor shower in the garden, a clothes line, and a rack for your boards.

copyBlocks.heading: Six kinds of room
copyBlocks.body: Booking.com lists six, starting with a single for one person and going up to a family room for four. Each one has its own entrance, and its own bathroom with a shower.

copyBlocks.heading: Getting here
copyBlocks.body:
Koggala Airport is 11 km away. If you want a taxi from the airport, let us know and we'll arrange one. There's a charge.

The nearest train station is Kumbalgama, about a 13-minute walk. Midigama station is 1.4 km away. Booking.com puts the centre of Weligama 3.3 km from the house.

On Google Maps, look for Coconut Surf Inn Guest House and Restaurant.

spot: Coconuts, a consistent A-frame reef break, is in front of the guesthouse. Plantations is a more mellow wave, a 100 m walk up the beach.
season: According to the Sri Lanka Travel Pages surf guide, the season at Coconut Point runs from November to April.
hoursNote: The restaurant upstairs is open every day from 7:30 to 22:00.

rooms.note: Ground floor, 19 m². Air conditioning, fan and hot water.

rooms.label: Deluxe Family Room

rooms.note: 28 m², with a balcony and a garden view. Air conditioning, fan and hot water.

stayInfo.note: Children of any age are welcome, but there are no cots or extra beds. Pets are allowed on request, at no charge.

amenities.label: Swimwear and snacks for sale at the entrance

testimonials.quote: We had a fantastic experience here. The rooms are spacious and clean, the breakfast is delicious and it has a magical rooftop with unbeatable views of coconut beach. The staff is warm and welcoming and went above and beyond to give our kids a memorable time. We whole heartedly recommend this place and wish we could stay much longer.
testimonials.author: Erin, Germany

testimonials.quote: Excellent, warm and very helpful staff. The best breakfast we've had in recent years while traveling. (We stayed there for 3 weeks and didn't get tired). Very comfortable restaurant area with many "lying around" areas. The room was as expected.
testimonials.author: Janno, Estonia

testimonials.quote:
The Staff were absolutely lovely. The kitchen staff especially, always so warm and welcoming and always had a smile on their face. We loved having a chat with them every day, they really made the stay. The chefs make some delicious food, the sesame tuna was our favourite. 
The rooftop is a lovely place to chill out and the rooms were clean. Location great to walk to the surf.
testimonials.author: Meagan, Jersey

testimonials.quote:
Great location and area - this part of midigama is the best with multiple surf breaks nearby as well as little beach shacks to watch the surf and turtles and plenty of swimming spots around. The hotel was 100m walk to the beach and plenty of tuk tuks to take you to wherever else in the area you might want to go. 
Room and hotel was clean and nice, staff were lovely and the restaurant had a great view. Having breakfast included made it even better value for money.
testimonials.author: Chloe, Australia

testimonials.quote: amazing location 2 minute walk to plantations and coconuts surf break. set away from the main road so was very quiet. breakfast and dinner was very nice and reasonably priced. rooms very clean and offered to clean daily if needed. staff very friendly
testimonials.author: Elinor, United Kingdom

testimonials.quote: The owners were very friendly and accommodating. Chinthaka and the entire team provided great service. The rooms are spacious and comfortable and the bathrooms are very clean. The rooftop area was especially lovely with a great view of the beach where you can watch the surfers and relax. The prices are incredibly reasonable as well for the rooms and services provided. Very impressed! :)
testimonials.author: V, Sri Lanka

testimonials.quote:
I booked my first 5 days here but ended up staying here 2,5 weeks in total. 
Great location close to coconut beach. Rooms were fresh but mostely the staff there was so friendly and amazing! Made me feel like home as a solo travaler! :)
testimonials.author: Mette, Sweden

testimonials.quote: This place is a vibe! Also the staff are super cool, they let me leave my stuff with them on the last day so I could surf in the evening which was great. Location is beside a lesser known but still surfable beach, which is awesome. If you want to go into Weligama, it’s a 5 minute tuk tuk, easy :)
testimonials.author: Liam, Switzerland

testimonials.quote: Short walk to Coconuts and Plantations surf breaks. Located in a quiet spot away from the main road. Spacious, clean room. Restaurant on site and roof top terrace with good views. Great value for money.
testimonials.author: Dean, United Kingdom

testimonials.quote:
Incredibly friendly and accommodating staff!! Very kind and willing to help us with any of our requests. 

Our rooms were recently built with A/C + fans. Place is very close to good beaches for surfing with lots of stuff nearby. Fantastic views from the rooftop each morning for breakfast (just note that it takes quite a bit of time for food to be ready but its all quite tasty!)
testimonials.author: Abdulrahman, United Kingdom

testimonials.quote: Great location near to beach. The restaurant is on the second floor and has great views and great tea choices. Breakky was included and tasty. Smiley staff.
testimonials.author: Rosa, Australia

testimonials.quote: The property is beautiful and the rooftop has an incredible view of the sea. The staff were incredibly helpful and attentive to any need - you can tell that everyone that works there loves to be there
testimonials.author: Tadiwa, United Kingdom
